svg.aria-label: 10:00 · Code ships. Lysbor. SaaS · open demo. When a team writes software, security flaws slip in. Lysbor reviews every new version, finds the flaws and says who must fix what, and by when. It also warns you when European law requires a problem to be reported. Lysbor: code is reviewed and three issues come out as an action plan with owners and deadlines
